items.question: ---- scheduling an examination at Central Wellness Clinic, clients will be asked a few health-related questions.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：___ scheduling an examination 是省略主语的时间状语从句。 选择理由：When scheduling相当于 when clients are scheduling，B正确。正确答案：B（When）。
items.evidence: 参考原文第 1 段第 1 句：---- scheduling an examination at Central Wellness Clinic, clients will be asked a few health-related questions.

items.question_translation: ---- 在中央健康诊所预约检查时，客户会被问到几个与健康相关的问题。
items.grammar_point: 省略式时间状语从句：When scheduling 相当于 When clients schedule；从句主语与主句主语一致时可省略主语和 be。
